Subject: Renewal uplift — capacity and billing timing

Lukas,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick recap from our side: OrchardAI is forecasting an ongoing usage increase and we'd like to add a 2.5M token/month uplift effective Sept 1 to avoid throttling our inbound pipelines. Our preference is to co-term the uplift with our existing contract so everything aligns to 2027-01-31.

Key asks from procurement:
- Formal uplift proposal with blended pricing and a recommended billing schedule by Jul 30
- Sample invoice phasing (we'd prefer smoothing across months rather than a single large invoice)
- Any required PO wording or amendment stub so procurement can pre-stage approvals

Can you confirm whether Redwood supports a staggered-credit handoff (split invoice across 3 periods) and what discount bands would apply at the 2.5M/month level? I can loop in our finance contact if needed — procurement@orchardai.com is copied.

Appreciate a proposal we can share internally.

Best,
Erica

Subject: OrchardAI uplift proposal (options)

Erica / Lukas —

Attached is a short proposal (OrchardAI_uplift_proposal_v1.pdf) with two options. TL;DR below, full numbers in the attachment.

Option A — Smooth billing (recommended if you want predictable monthly OPEX):
- Add 2.5M tokens/month starting 2026-09-01
- Billing: split uplift into three invoices: 50% at amendment signing (Sep), 25% on Nov 1, 25% on Jan 1 (co-term).
- Pricing: small blended uplift discount (5% off list for the uplift bucket) given mid-contract add-on. No change to base contract.

Option B — Commit-forward (recommended to maximize unit discount):
- Convert uplift to committed incremental capacity for remainder of term (co-term to 2027-01-31)
- Billing: invoice 100% at signing or spread across 2 installments (50/50) if needed
- Pricing: larger discount (10% off list) for upfront commitment; includes priority capacity during bursts.

A few notes:
- We can craft a hybrid (50% commit/50% monthly top-up) if you want some smoothing + a larger discount on the committed portion.
- Both options include the same SLA and burst-bucket behavior.
- If OrchardAI needs a PO clause that references the staggered schedule, we can include sample language in the amendment.

Next steps I recommend: pick A/B/hybrid, confirm invoice recipient and signer, and confirm whether you want us to present a DocuSign amendment or a tracked Word draft. I've attached the proposal PDF and included example numbers.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
